newsitem.title: ITALY: Italians rally in support of hero Di Pietro.
newsitem.headline: Italians rally in support of hero Di Pietro.

text.p: About 200 people took part in a demonstration on Sunday to protest against a corruption inquiry into former anti-graft magistrate Antonio Di Pietro, one of Italy's most popular public figures.
They carried placards reading "Long live Di Pietro" and "Our Future is in Your Clean Hands."
The demonstrators gathered in Rome's central Piazza del Popolo and marched to a nearby theatre for speeches. They said a second candle-lit march at the Colosseum would be held on Sunday evening.
Di Pietro resigned as public works minister last month after magistrates in the northern town of Brescia opened an investigation into alleged irregularities in his work as a magistrate.
Di Pietro quit the famous "Clean Hands" pool of anti-graft magistrates in Milan two years ago after having spearheaded the corruption probes which brought down Italy's political establishment.

A week ago, tax police raided his homes and offices and seized documents in an operation his supporters called "execessive". Di Pietro has himself slammed the probe as "a joke and a squalid vendetta".
